verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform covering contract creation, signing, storage, workflows and APIs. Acting as a registered agent that receives scanned legal mail and service of process belongs to business-formation and compliance services, so this axis is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Ironclad offers registered-agent or mail-scanning services.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally
